title: Telemetry: mark throttled requests
description: When an integration hits the rate limit we cannot tell from the telemetry who it was. The request log line now gets a `throttled` field on 429 responses, identifying the client, so a throttled integration can be told apart from anonymous traffic. Test added.

defects.explanation: Writes the raw bearer token of a throttled dealer into the telemetry log; logs must never contain tokens (log the dealer id or a hash instead).
